blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Calamba City government in Laguna urged residents on Wednesday noon to take extra precautions against extreme heat after the heat index reached 38°C. According to the latest monitoring, the heat index in Calamba City has reached 38°C, placing it under the “Extreme Caution” category, the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) said in an advisory in Filipino after recording the reading at 10 a.m. “Heat cramps and heat exhaustion may occur due to the intense heat, especially among those exposed to direct sunlight for prolonged periods,” the advisory stated.
